css:
*{box-sizing:border-box}#taskshop-app{--ts-ink:#222b32;--ts-muted:#6a777c;--ts-line:#e5e9e7;--ts-accent:#1e645d;--ts-bg:#f5f7f6;color:var(--ts-ink);background:var(--ts-bg);font:13px/1.5 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;min-height:100%;padding:14px 12px 22px}#taskshop-app button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}#taskshop-app [hidden]{display:none!important}.ts-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px;padding:0 2px}.ts-logo{height:34px;width:34px;flex:none;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ts-accent);color:#fff;font-size:20px;font-weight:750;text-align:center;line-height:34px}.ts-brand{display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}.ts-brand strong{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.4px}.ts-brand span{font-size:11px;color:var(--ts-muted)}.ts-icon{border:1px solid var(--ts-line);background:white;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;font-size:21px!important;color:var(--ts-ink)}.ts-disclaimer{background:#eaf3f1;border:1px solid #d5e8e1;color:#28594f;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:12px}.ts-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--ts-line);border-radius:13px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #18342a07}.ts-line{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.ts-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3px;color:var(--ts-accent);font-weight:700}.ts-pill{border:1px solid #e7e3cf;background:#f9f7ed;color:#736335;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 6px;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}.ts-card h1{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.45px;line-height:1.35;margin:13px 0 7px}.ts-card h2{margin:0;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:-.2px}.ts-sub{color:var(--ts-muted);font-size:12px;margin:6px 0 12px;line-height:1.7}.ts-divider{height:1px;background:var(--ts-line);margin:14px 0}.ts-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 17px}.ts-metrics div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;background:#f5f8f7;padding:10px;border-radius:9px}.ts-metrics span{font-size:11px;color:var(--ts-muted)}.ts-metrics strong{font-size:17px;font-weight:720}.ts-details{margin:0;display:grid;gap:10px}.ts-details div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding-bottom:9px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1ef}.ts-details div:last-child{border:0;padding:0}.ts-details dt{color:var(--ts-muted);min-width:68px;font-size:11px}.ts-details dd{font-size:11px;margin:0;text-align:right;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:70%}.ts-state{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:#edf3f2;color:#285e57;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 9px}.ts-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:85px 1fr;gap:8px 10px;margin:13px 0;font-size:11px}.ts-meta span:nth-child(odd){color:var(--ts-muted)}.ts-meta span:nth-child(even){text-align:right;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ts-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.ts-btn{background:white;border:1px solid #cbd9d4;color:#275750;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:650!important;min-height:36px}.ts-btn.ts-primary{background:var(--ts-accent);color:white;border-color:var(--ts-accent)}.ts-btn:disabled{cursor:wait;opacity:.5}.ts-btn:focus-visible,.ts-icon:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #358b80;outline-offset:2px}.ts-btn:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.95)}.ts-status{color:var(--ts-muted);font-size:11px;margin:10px 0 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ts-error{border:1px solid #e5b2a6;color:#8d392d;background:#fff1ed;border-radius:9px;padding:11px;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px}.ts-tech dd{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10px}.ts-footer{padding:6px;color:var(--ts-muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.8}@media(max-width:340px){.ts-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ts-details div{display:block}.ts-details dd{text-align:left;max-width:100%;margin-top:3px}.ts-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3px}.ts-meta span:nth-child(even){text-align:left;margin-bottom:8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ts-btn{transition:background .15s,filter .15s}}
.ts-results{white-space:pre-line;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin-bottom:0}
